description_en: Queries the precheck information of SQL statements used for data import in a ticket
description_zh: 获取数据导入预检SQL详情
name: ListDataImportSQLPreCheckDetail

parameters.help_en: The ticket ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to query the ticket ID
parameters.help_zh: 工单ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SQL statement. Valid values:

SELECT
INSERT
DELETE
CREATE_TABLE

You can log on to the Data Management (DMS) console and choose Security and Specifications > Operation Audit in the top navigation bar to view more types of SQL statements
parameters.help_zh:
SQL类型，常见SQL类型取值说明如下：
SELECT：查询
INSERT：插入
DELETE：删除
CREATE_TABLE：创建表

您可以在顶部菜单栏中，选择安全与规范>操作审计，查看更多SQL类型取值
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en:
The state of the ticket. If you leave this parameter empty, all the states are queried by default. Valid values:

INIT: The ticket is being initialized.
RUNNING: The ticket is in progress.
SUCCESS: The ticket is complete.
TIMEOUT: The ticket is skipped due to timeout.
FAIL: The ticket fails
parameters.help_zh:
工单状态。若不填，则默认选择所有状态，其他取值如下：
INIT：初始化。
RUNNING：执行中。
SUCCESS：已完成。
TIMEOUT：超时跳过。
FAIL：已失败
parameters.name: status_code

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_numer

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

PreCheckSQLDetailList.description_en: The precheck information of SQL statements

items.description_en: The precheck information of the SQL statement

Skip.description_en:
Indicates whether the precheck of the SQL statement was skipped. Valid values:

true
false
Skip.description_zh:
是否存在跳过预检查SQL的情况。取值如下：
true：存在。
false：不存在

SqlId.description_en: The SQL ID, which indicates the sequence number of the SQL statement. The number starts with 1
SqlId.description_zh: SQL ID，表示是第几个SQL，从1开始

SqlType.description_en: The type of the SQL statement, such as DELETE, UPDATE, or ALTER_TABLE

StatusCode.description_en:
The state of the ticket. Valid values:

INIT: The ticket was being initialized.
RUNNING: The ticket was in progress.
SUCCESS: The ticket was complete.
TIMEOUT: The ticket was skipped due to timeout.
FAIL: The ticket failed
StatusCode.description_zh:
工单状态。取值如下：
INIT：初始化。
RUNNING：执行中。
SUCCESS：已完成。
TIMEOUT：超时跳过。
FAIL：已失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。可用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
